labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Reports a broken link in CONTRIBUTING.md (AI_POLICY.md link points at master); the PR question is answered by the same docs.

items.body:
Thanks for reporting this. The link to AI_POLICY.md in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) still points at `master`, which is why it returns a 404.

On opening a pull request: pull requests are limited to collaborators, and contributors describe the change in an issue first, as [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains. This issue does that. Please read [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) before using AI tools on any contribution.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
